jsesh.bzr
Interface BzrFontBuilder

All Known Implementing Classes:
BzrSimpleFontBuilder, BzrToStringBuilder
public interface BzrFontBuilder

interface used for building actual representation of a BZR font. Use design pattern builder. Role in Design Pattern is Builder. Created: Sun Jun 2 12:43:07 2002

Author:
Serge ROSMORDUC

public void startChar(int code,
                      double width,
                      double left,
                      double bottom,
                      double right,
                      double up)
Called when the reader starts reading a new char.

Parameters:
code - the code of the char, between 0 and 255.
width - the width of char.
left - leftmost x position for the char
bottom - y position for the char (y axis is upward-oriented)
right - rightmost x position for the char
up - upper y position for the char.
